definition: A large sacrifice of animals offered publicly to a god or gods.
author: Homer
quote: Meanwhile the heralds were bringing the holy hecatomb through the city, and the Achaeans gathered under the shady grove of Apollo.
example_sentence: Hundreds of cattle were offered in a hecatomb to the gods.
